method: Upward rays from actual Support, Support transition and Support interface extrusion midpoint bins; top midpoint in each 0.8 x 0.8 x 1.0 mm bin, capped at 16000 rays per body. Hits 0.10 to 2.0 mm above the path are retained. Shared bbox membership may overlap where bodies meet.
limitation: Bounded support-proximity samples locate contacted or nearby down-facing surfaces. They do not establish complete contact boundaries, removal effort, finish or absence of every small contact. Unlabelled interfaces remain unlabelled in the topology audit.
